blurb: Guests choose river trips on 22 miles of the Elm Fork of the Trinity River, starting at the location in Coppell, TX. Trips range from 2-3 hours to 5-6 hours covering distances from 2 to 12 miles. Paddle orientation is provided, and shuttles are available to return guests to the starting point.
